projects.title: Smart Parking & Building Hub
projects.subtitle: Real-time Slot Allocation & Analytics
projects.businessGoal: Reduce search times for open parking spots by 45%, automate ticketing systems, and optimize slot allocations during peak building hours to increase operations efficiency.
projects.challenges: Handling highly concurrent spot reservation requests from hundreds of users simultaneously without race conditions (double bookings), and displaying live, fluid slot status grids in the client browser.
projects.learnings: Mastered database pessimistic locks and Redis caching for high-speed transaction handling. Gained deep experience in real-time WebSockets communication and fluid rendering of responsive SVG grids in React.
